title: fix(cash): reconcile per-dimension cost parts with the billed total, or mark them as estimates
description:
## .what

the cash report of an openrouter ask carries per-dimension parts (input, cacheWrite, cacheRead, output) that are spec-rate estimates, beside a total that is the charge openrouter billed. the parts do not sum to the total, and nothing marks them as estimates.

checkable evidence: asCashWithSupplyTotal (0.1.3) keeps the spec estimate for each part and replaces only total. one deepseek/flash ask:

| dimension | written | basis |
|---|---|---|
| input | $0.000623100 / 2,077 tok | $0.30/M |
| cacheRead | $0.000384000 / 1,280 tok | $0.30/M, no discount |
| output | $0.000452000 / 226 tok | spec |
| total | $0.000236230 | billed |

the parts sum to about 6 times the billed total. a consumer that derives a figure from the parts (a cache-saved amount, a per-dimension share) reads a projection as a measurement; one meter showed cacheGet 1280 beside cacheSaved $0.

## .why

the parts and the total disagree, and a consumer cannot tell which to trust without an arithmetic check of its own. #15 asks to price cache.get at the catalog cache-read rate, which narrows the gap but does not reconcile the parts with the billed total.

## .shape of the fix

pick one, in order of preference:
1. where the usage payload carries a per-dimension charge, write measured parts
2. else scale the spec parts so they sum to the billed total, and mark them scaled
3. at minimum, declare the provenance: a parts field of estimate or measured on the cash report, so a consumer branches on a declared fact

clamp: a cash case whose parts sum to the billed total (or whose parts are marked estimate when they do not).
